mechanism: Append fixed causal last wind/rotor and 1h/3h wind/power/rotor differences to Wiki neighbor keys. Refit distance standardization/support radius on the exact same original donor cases. Same case outcomes, neighbors32, support quantile0.95, readout, confidence model, parameters and loss. No additional memory labels or refreshed case pool.
train_side_evidence: Memory/early donor training data show future power changes correlated with recent dynamics omitted from old 12h-summary keys: memory power3h correlations -0.4459/-0.3175 vs six-hour-half difference -0.1096/-0.1531; early last wind -0.0948/-0.2263. This is association, not proof of transfer. A train-only fresh-bank check improved selection but worsened later calibration; reject freshness-only as a fix and do not append those cases.
fit: Exact saved v7 memory360 + early685 donor1-5 windows. Memory-period queries remain unsupported until the original bank matures. No new donor labels or numerical input changes.
selection: Same v7 115-window chronological epoch selection and joint MAE/RMSE non-worse criterion, with exact epoch0 fallback
benefit_calibration: Same v7 110-window later training-only certificate; recompute actual predictions and bind new checkpoint, bank, coordinate implementation, and unchanged numerical gate identity
controls: Reuse completed v8 anchored old-key and direct old-key outputs plus v7 free Wiki, zero-memory and numerical controls; no control retraining. Fixed DirectDynamicsCase confidence1 gets its own new certificate, not a threshold search.
primary_success: DynamicsWikiSelective must improve both MAE/RMSE over CertifiedNumeric/Persistence, old-key CaseAnchoredWikiSelective, frozen FreeWikiSelective and ZeroMemorySelective, and DirectDynamicsCaseSelective. Report all raw candidates without posthoc promotion.
budget: One new fold1 seed2024 20-epoch confidence expert; no automatic seed/fold expansion or follow-up coordinate/threshold search
resource_policy: Adaptive sharing: process-local 2GiB allocator budget, two CPU threads and cooperative yielding with other compute tasks; no cap/delay when alone; never modify other processes
forbidden: new case labels or numerical refits
limitations: Historically inspected development fold, not independent confirmation. Short-history association may drift. A changed coordinate is a testable engineering hypothesis, not established novelty or a guarantee of precision. Raw improvements cannot replace the predeclared selective method.
